item.title: [IGNITE-2971] Assertion error inside OPTIMISTIC SERIALIZABLE tx on 'get'
item.description:
The following code leads to assertion below:

                final IgniteCache cache = jcache().withKeepBinary();

                Set keys = new LinkedHashSet() {{
                    for (int i = 0; i < CNT; i++)
                        add(key(i));
                }};

                try (Transaction tx = testedGrid().transactions().txStart(conc, isolation)) {
                    for (final Object key : keys) {
                        Object res = cache.invoke(key, NOOP_ENTRY_PROC);

                        assertNull(res);

                        assertNull(cache.get(key));
                    }

                    tx.commit();
                }

Assertion:

java.lang.AssertionError: Wrong version [serReadVer=GridCacheVersion [topVer=71859233, time=1460379235380, order=1460379231642, nodeOrder=5], ver=GridCacheVersion [topVer=71859233, time=1460379235380, order=1460379231642, nodeOrder=5]]
